name: Maple Street Bakery
summary: A concept website for a neighbourhood bakery: menu, hours and one-tap ordering by phone.
description: Many small bakeries rely on a PDF menu and a Facebook page. This concept shows what a fast, phone-first site could look like instead.
Built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS, hosted for free on Cloudflare Pages.
